brief_rationale: The trajectory ultimately built a highly executable nephrology and medication-reconciliation plan, with the patient obtaining renal follow-up, labs, a written 40 mg valsartan plan, and clear separation of the 80 mg supply. However, there were minor/moderate responsibility-chain errors: an unsupported “statin” attribution was introduced before being corrected, and the urgent-escalation list remained incomplete even after the patient asked whether there were other signs to remember. Under the frozen rubric, any minor/moderate responsibility-chain error caps the grade at 2 despite later mitigation and multiple completed high-order actions.
